The AppImage runtime of Immuch360 Desktop

The first part of the Immuch360 Desktop AppImage file is the AppImage runtime, the program that mounts or extracts
the rest of the file and starts the app: runtime-x86_64 of the release 20251108 of type2-runtime,
https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime, built from its commit dd6cebedcbddde9c82f89b011e8e1d40b6e43868.

The runtime is under the MIT licence (LICENSE of type2-runtime, in the archive of its source next to this file). It
contains statically linked code from:
  * libfuse 3.15.0, under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 or later
    (https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse), with the patch patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff of type2-runtime;
  * squashfuse 0.5.2, under the BSD 2-Clause licence (https://github.com/vasi/squashfuse);
  * musl libc, zstd, zlib and mimalloc, under the MIT, BSD and zlib licences, from Alpine Linux.

The corresponding source of the runtime is next to this file, as its build script fetches and checks it:
  * type2-runtime-dd6cebedcbddde9c82f89b011e8e1d40b6e43868.tar.gz, the source of the runtime, its build scripts and
    the patch it applies to libfuse;
  * fuse-3.15.0.tar.xz, the source of libfuse;
  * squashfuse-0.5.2.tar.gz, the source of squashfuse.
With them, scripts/chroot/build.sh of type2-runtime rebuilds the runtime, with libfuse changed or not. Each archive is
also checked by its SHA-256 in .github/desktop/packaging/linux/appimage/appimage.lock.json of
https://github.com/freeKC/Immuch360.

The text of the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 is LICENCE-LGPL-2.1.txt next to this file.

The AppImage was made with appimagetool 1.9.1 (MIT, https://github.com/AppImage/appimagetool), which is not part of
it.
